data.name: Phileon
data.long_meaning: The name Phileon comes from the Greek word φιλεω (phileō), which means 'to love, to be fond of, to be kind to, to be a friend to'. In the New Testament, Philemon is mentioned in the Epistle of Paul to Philemon, which is believed to have been written around AD 54. In this letter, Paul asks Philemon to receive his friend Onesimus, who had run away from Philemon and later came to Paul. Philemon is described as a beloved and faithful brother in Christ, and Paul asks him to receive Onesimus not as a slave, but as a brother in Christ.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the love and friendship that should exist between all believers in Christ.
data.numerology_meaning: A name that represents change, freedom, and creativity.

in_hebrew.name: פילאון
in_hebrew.meaning: אהוב על ידי אלוהים או אהוב של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פילאון הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'אהוב על ידי אלוהים' או 'אהוב של אלוהים'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'פִילוֹς' (philos), שפירושה 'אהבה' או 'חיבה', ומהמילה 'אֵל' (El), שפירושה 'אלוהים'. השם פילאון משמש כזכר וכנושא לשם התואר 'אלקים' (אלוהים) במשמעות רוחנית.

in_greek.name: Φιλέων
in_greek.meaning: Φίλος του Θεού ή Αγαπητός του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Φιλέων είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'φίλος του Θεού' ή 'αγαπητός του Θεού'. Το όνομα αυτό προκύπτει από τη σύνθεση των λέξεων 'φίλος' (philos), που σημαίνει 'αγάπη' ή 'φιλία', και 'Θεός' (Theos), που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Στην πλούσια πολιτιστική και πνευματική παράδοση της Ελλάδας, το όνομα Φιλέων φέρει σημαντική βαρύτητα ως σύμβολο πνευματικής σύνδεσης και αγάπης προς το Θείο.

in_latin.name: Phileon
in_latin.long_meaning: Phileon, derived from Greek roots, signifies 'Amicus Dei' or 'Dilectus Dei', meaning 'friend of God' or 'beloved of God'. This name carries profound spiritual significance, reflecting a deep and intimate relationship with the Divine. Historically, names with such connotations were often bestowed upon individuals in early Christian communities to express their devotion and commitment to their faith.

in_english.name: Phileon
in_english.meaning: Friend of God or Beloved of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Phileon originates from Greek roots, specifically from the words 'philos' (love) and 'theos' (God), collectively meaning 'friend of God' or 'beloved of God'. This name holds significant spiritual and biblical connotations, symbolizing a profound bond of love and devotion between the individual and God. Historically, such names were chosen to reflect the values and aspirations of Christian communities, emphasizing the importance of faith and spiritual connection.

pronunciation.biblical: Φιλέων (pronounced as fee-LEH-on in ancient Greek)

biblical_reference.note: Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name's components and meaning reflect themes common in biblical narratives.

data.cultural_impact: The name Phileon has been used throughout history, not only as a given name, but also as a term for deep affection and friendship. It highlights the Greco-Roman ideal of philia – the brotherly love between individuals, pushing boundaries of social class and status. The name carries an aura of kindness, generosity, and deep connection that can inspire meaningful relationships across cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian traditions, the name Phileon represents the love of God for humanity and the call for Christians to embody the love of Christ in their relationships. It resonates with the idea of forgiveness, reconciliation, and brotherhood, echoing the message of Paul's letter to Philemon and inspiring us to extend the same grace and love towards others – particularly to those who have wronged us.

historical_references.reference: Philemon was a Christian bishop of Thyatira in the province of Asia Minor around 40-60 AD. He is mentioned in the New Testament Epistle of Paul to Philemon.
Philemon of Gaza (circa 300 AD) was a notable Christian philosopher, known for his works on Christian ethics, and was a teacher of St. Augustine.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Phileon, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Phileon meaning "Lover, friend" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Phileon, derived from the Greek word for "loving," symbolizes the Christian ideal of selfless, agape love. In the New Testament, Philemon is a biblical character known for his loving hospitality towards Saint Paul. Spiritually, the name represents the call to extend forgiveness and love, just as Philemon did to Onesimus, who had run away from him.
